evals.prompt: That consent form went to forty parents last week. Who still hasn't returned it, and can you chase just those?
evals.expected_output: Per-person signing status read before any reminder, and a reminder sent only to those still awaiting signature.
assertions: The document is read before any reminder is sent
Per-person signing status is used, not the document status alone
Only recipients still awaiting signature are included in the reminder
Nobody who has already signed is included

evals.prompt: I typed Maria's email wrong - it went to maria@exmaple.com. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The existing recipient corrected in place rather than a second document created.
assertions: The existing signee's contact detail is corrected rather than a new document being created
The reply does not propose revoking and resending as the first option
The reply says what happens to the invitation after the correction

evals.prompt: The download link you gave me this morning doesn't work any more.
evals.expected_output: The ten-minute window named as the cause and a fresh link fetched, without claiming the link was single-use.
assertions: The reply attributes the failure to the ten-minute window elapsing
The reply does not claim the signed-document link was consumed by being used once
A fresh link is fetched rather than the user being told to wait
